name: Special Ops - Commando Shooting Game
summary:
Enter the heart-pounding world of elite combat in Special Ops – Commando Shooting Game, a fully immersive VR experience for Meta Quest. Take control of a skilled commando and face challenging missions where precision, strategy, and reflexes are your keys to survival. Engage in intense firefights, eliminate enemy forces, and complete tactical objectives across diverse, realistic environments.
